description.value: La Ruota Pizzeria is a Neapolitan-style pizza chain that hand-crafts its pies in a 900° oven using Caputo '00' flour and ingredients sourced from both Italy and BC. The West 4th Avenue location sits on one of Vancouver's key cycling corridors near the Arbutus Greenway. The chain operates a franchise model with multiple Metro Vancouver locations and an online ordering app.
